## General

- Vision has been regranted at Heletes' Forge
- Familiar health and mana bars are now hidden (in a similar fashion as the quest givers)
- Adjusted Calliope's position and the surrounding terrain to allow players to return quests to her without going all the way around

### Typos & Typesetting

- Nature's Bulwark (Guardian of Nature)
- Book of Skill Increase (Books)
  - Shiv (Assassin)
  - Shadowstrike (Assassin)
  - Pirouette (Assassin)
  - Invigorate (Temple Guardian)
  - Winds of War (Warlord)
- `-amok` (chat command)
- Adamantium Helm
- Unyielding Breastplate
- Wizard's Respite

## Bug Fixes

- Town teleporters can no longer teleport dummy units, e.g., Hallowed Ground's (Cleric) FX
- `-info` no longer truncates the ")" for heroes whose base attack cooldown is 3 seconds
- Tisiphone (Frozen Citadel) can no longer cast *War Stomp* while taunted
- Rebirth (Cleric) tooltips now update whenever a hero levels up
- Gore (Goretusk) now displays its intended icon

## Heroes

- Rage (Barbarian)
  - Mana restored per auto-attack: 0.03 × Level + 4 ⇒ 0.04 × Level + 5
- Unbridled Khaos (Khaos Champion)
  - Proc: 10% ⇒ 12.5%
- Phalanx (Spartan Warrior)
  - Tooltip now explicitly explains that its skill level increases automatically at Levels 15 / 45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 / 180

## Items

- Summoning Stones now has a suffix corresponding to the boss who dropped it
- Amphirite's Cloak
  - Level: 135 ⇒ 165
  - Requirement: *Circlet of the Mother Goddess* ⇒ *Unyielding Breastplate*
  - Armor: 0 ⇒ 30
  - Mana: 1500 ⇒ 750
- Adamantium Set (Item Ability)
  - *Adamantium Lance*
    - Whenever you equip two or more items with Adamantium Set:<br>
&nbsp;• 2+ Items: Grants Critical Strike IV.<br>
&nbsp;• 3 Items: Increases Agility by 35.
  - *Adamantium Helm*
    - Whenever you equip two or more items with Adamantium Set:<br>
&nbsp;• 2+ Items: Increases Resist by 15.<br>
&nbsp;• 3 Items: Increases Resist by 20.
  - *Adamantium Tower*
    - Whenever you equip two or more items with Adamantium Set:<br>
&nbsp;• 2+ Items: Increases Strength by 35.<br>
&nbsp;• 3 Items: Grants Block II.
  - Previously<small><br><em>Whenever you equip two or more items with Adamantium Set:<br>
&nbsp;• 2+ Items: Increases Resist by 15. Grants Critical Strike IV.<br>
&nbsp;• 3 Items: Increases Strength by 45 and Resist by 20. Grants Block II.</em></small>
- Cleave I / II (Item Ability)
  - Your auto-attacks also deal 0.3 / 0.6 Primary Attribute physical damage to nearby enemies within a 200 AoE of the target.
  - Affects *Deathchill Blade*, *Deathchill Greatsword*, and *Red Dragonscale Ring of Serious Addiction* downstream
  - Previously<small><br>*Your auto-attacks also deal 1.0 / 1.5 bonus Primary Attribute physical damage to enemies in a 200 AoE of the target, including the target itself.*</small>
